displayIdentity.body: Paul says he received and delivered the tradition: on the night betrayed Jesus took bread, gave thanks, named body and remembrance, then named the cup as new covenant and repeated remembrance until he comes.
displayIdentity.title: Paul transmits what he received about the night of betrayal
